name: Enemies
overview: The Telegin family has completed the construction of their dreams — in a remote village near Yelets, a fashionable barnhouse has been erected on the site of their parents' old summer house. For this, Igor, an IT specialist, and his wife Daria, a practicing psychologist, had to go into debt, but there was no other way out — doctors recommended that their son with an immune disease live in an ecologically clean area.
